title: Nature Walk Beargrass House | KEY.co
description_expanded: - NatureWalk community, not beachfront. The beach is roughly a mile away via the Lilly Lane nature trail through Point Washington State Forest — a scenic bike ride or short LSV run, not a walk. Eight additional public access points are within 2.5 miles. - Golf cart and bikes included. A low-speed vehicle (LSV) and adult bikes come with every stay, making the beach trip and the hop to Seaside and WaterColor genuinely easy. - Community pool complex, not a private pool. The NatureWalk Gathering Place — across the community bridge — includes two pools, a hot tub, a children's splash pool, a playground, firepit, grills, and an entertainment bar. One pool is seasonally heated; the hot tub is a separate amenity. - Four screened porches plus multiple balconies. Outdoor living is a real feature here — there's also a garage refrigerator for keeping drinks cold without trekking inside. - Primary suite has a soaking tub and oversized walk-in shower. The main bedroom includes a private balcony entrance and a TV. A sofa bed in the living area extends capacity beyond the four bedrooms. - Minimal starter supplies. Stock up before you settle in — or use KEY.co grocery delivery to have provisions waiting on arrival.

Features: Balcony Patio Firepit Pool Outdoor grill Garden
